description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended durvalumab for the treatment of locally advanced unresectable non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) in adults whose tumours express PD-L1 on 1% or more of cells and whose disease has not progressed after concurrent platinum-based chemoradiation. Durvalumab is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
